user.title: BTicino C300X
user.description: Enter the C300X address first. If the native device agent is not reachable, Home Assistant can guide a one-shot agent install before collecting tokens and feature options.

data_description.callback_base_url: Leave empty for normal setups. Use only when Home Assistant generates a callback URL the C300X cannot reach, for example with an HTTPS frontend/reverse proxy, homeassistant.local, or link-local IPv6. Must be local HTTP, e.g. http://HA_LOCAL_IP:8123.

agent_missing.title: Native agent not found
agent_missing.description: Home Assistant could not reach the C300X native agent at the configured address. You can install the bundled native agent now, or continue if you want to configure an already installed agent manually.

data.bootstrap_install_agent: Install native agent on the C300X

bootstrap_install.title: Install native C300X agent
bootstrap_install.description: This writes the native agent, generated token config, startup script, and QML support files to the C300X through SSH. SSH credentials are used only for this install step and are not stored.

agent_auth.title: Device agent credentials
agent_auth.description: Enter the token details for the reachable native agent. Leave the API token empty only while the agent is still in noAuth bootstrap mode.

user_dashboard.title: C300X GUI dashboard
user_dashboard.description:
Configure the optional C300X display dashboard and GUI function patch.

Current device GUI function patch status: {qml_patch_status}.

Applying or restoring the GUI patch writes QML files on the device, reloads the device UI, and can take up to about 60 seconds. The status changes only after the agent confirms the resulting state.
